systems.owner: direction des affaires médicales of a public hospital, with its direction de la gestion des malades

note: The passages are from hospital statutes approved by health ministry decrees of 31 December 2025 (the hospitals are not named in the passages): they charge the medical affairs directorate with gathering the information for the patient's medical file and managing the hospital information system, without saying whether either is digital or what the system does, so no fact.
